007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.credential;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Credential;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.CredentialConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for dropping a database credential used by Select AI.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
021 * {@link CredentialConfig} with a credential name, obtain a {@link Credential}
022 * object from {@link SelectAI#credential(CredentialConfig)}, call
023 * {@link Credential#drop(boolean)}, and print whether the drop operation
024 * succeeded.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>This sample changes database state by dropping the credential identified
027 * by {@code SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME}. Dropping a credential can break profiles
028 * or vector indexes that reference it.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
031 * <ul>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
035 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
036 * </ul>
037 *
038 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
039 * <ul>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_DROP_FORCE - set to {@code true} to treat an
041 *       already absent credential as success. Defaults to {@code false}.</li>
042 * </ul>
043 *
044 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
045 * <pre>{@code
046 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
047 * }</pre>
048 *
049 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
050 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
051 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
052 * <pre>{@code
053 * mvn clean install
054 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
055 * }</pre>
056 *
057 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
058 * <pre>{@code
059 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
060 *   -d samples/out \
061 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/credential/DropCredentialSample.java
062 * }</pre>
063 *
064 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
065 * <pre>{@code
066 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
067 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.credential.DropCredentialSample
068 * }</pre>
069 *
070 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
071 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
072 * and diagnostics.</p>
073 */
074public final class DropCredentialSample {
075    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DropCredentialSample.class);
076
077    private DropCredentialSample() {
078    }
079
080    public static void main(String[] args) {
081        String credentialName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME");
082        boolean force = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_DROP_FORCE", "false"));
083
084        try {
085            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
086            Credential credential = selectAI.credential(CredentialConfig.builder(credentialName).build());
087            boolean dropped = credential.drop(force);
088
089            System.out.printf("Drop credential '%s' completed: %s%n", credentialName, dropped);
090            System.out.printf("Force: %s%n", force);
091        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
092            LOGGER.error("Failed to drop Select AI credential '{}'.", credentialName, e);
093        }
094    }
095
096    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
097        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
098                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
099                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
100                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
101                .build();
102
103        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
104    }
105
106    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
107        String value = System.getenv(name);
108        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
109            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
110        }
111        return value;
112    }
113
114    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
115        String value = System.getenv(name);
116        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
117    }
118}
